title: Database lint — Supabase Splinter (agentsec live)
summary: Scheduled/manual Supabase Splinter DB lint against a live Postgres via agentsec live.
notes: Wraps `agentsec live --db-url ... --allow-remote-db`, which runs the pinned Supabase Splinter lint query against a live Postgres (via psql) and merges results into the unified report. The connection string is a real secret: set the `DATABASE_URL` repo secret (a Postgres DSN). The job skips with a notice if it is not set. A CI DSN is remote from the runner, so `--allow-remote-db` is passed to satisfy agentsec's locality guard — you are explicitly opting into a remote scan, so use a read-only / least-privilege role and a NON-PROD database. This is the CI counterpart of the production weekly Splinter scan, without vendoring project-specific scripts or a hardcoded DSN.
